title: Beacon Hill Camping

services.name: Cabins
services.desc: All rental units are dog friendly. Dogs in the units must be with you or be crated. Pet charge does apply. Please see Pet Policy page if you are bringing a dog. All units are smoke free. Fire rings and picnic tables are at each rental unit. In the cabins there is no plumbing, but our bathhouse is just a short walk away. Bring your own sleeping bags/linens, pillows, and towels. There is a queen size bed, small refrigerator, little counter and two bar stools in each cabin. Sleeps two.
